theme.en: AI Demand Presses the Whole Stack

dek.en: Capacity stories are moving from single-chip roadmaps into memory fabs, foundry pricing, packaging workarounds, and equipment exposure. The day's strongest signals show AI demand still absorbing supply, while export controls and local sourcing keep reshaping where that supply can move.
dek.zh: 产能叙事正在从单颗芯片路线图扩展到存储厂、代工价格、先进封装绕行方案和设备敞口。今天最强的信号显示，AI需求仍在吸收新增供给，同时出口管制和本土化采购继续改写供应流向。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Qualcomm pushes data-center-class AI toward smartphones
title.zh: Qualcomm试图把数据中心级AI能力推向手机

summary.en: Qualcomm is pitching smartphone silicon as a way to bring more data-center-style AI capability onto the device, according to the candidate feed. The practical question is memory bandwidth and power, not only TOPS: handset inference has to run within a thermal envelope that server accelerators never face. If Qualcomm can move larger models locally, it shifts some demand from cloud inference toward edge-optimized accelerators and high-bandwidth mobile memory.
summary.zh: 候选源称，Qualcomm正在把手机芯片定位为承载更多数据中心式AI能力的载体。真正的约束不只是TOPS，而是内存带宽和功耗：手机端推理必须在服务器加速器无需面对的热设计范围内运行。如果Qualcomm能把更大的模型放到本地执行，部分云端推理需求会转向边缘侧加速器和高带宽移动内存。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC is reported to seek a 10% advanced-node price hike
title.zh: 据报TSMC拟将先进制程价格上调10%

summary.en: A market report says TSMC may raise advanced-process pricing by 10%, while Goldman Sachs lifted its ADR target to $600. The number matters because AI accelerators and premium mobile SoCs have less room to avoid TSMC's leading nodes than older compute markets did. If the hike holds, customers are effectively paying for scarce N3/N2-class capacity and advanced packaging priority, not only wafer starts.
summary.zh: 市场报道称，TSMC可能把先进制程报价上调10%，同时Goldman Sachs将其ADR目标价上调至600美元。这个数字重要，是因为AI加速器和高端手机SoC比以往成熟计算市场更难绕开TSMC领先制程。如果涨价落地，客户支付的不只是晶圆投片量，还包括稀缺N3/N2级产能和先进封装优先级。

title.en: Huawei details hybrid bonding for a 3D-stacked Kirin design
title.zh: Huawei披露面向3D堆叠Kirin设计的混合键合工艺

summary.en: Huawei described a hybrid-bonding path for a 2026 Kirin 3D-stacked design, framing packaging as a way to recover bandwidth and efficiency while access to advanced lithography remains constrained. The candidate report says the work targets better efficiency and bandwidth through vertical integration rather than a simple node shrink. That keeps advanced packaging central to China's mobile-silicon roadmap when EUV access is unavailable.
summary.zh: Huawei披露了面向2026年Kirin 3D堆叠设计的混合键合路径，把先进封装作为在先进光刻受限时恢复带宽和能效的手段。候选报道称，这项工作通过垂直集成提升效率和带宽，而不是依赖单纯制程缩小。在无法获得EUV的背景下，先进封装仍是中国移动芯片路线图的核心工具。

title.en: Memory & Storage
title.zh: 存储与SSD

title.en: Micron breaks ground on a $9.3B Hiroshima HBM expansion
title.zh: Micron启动广岛93亿美元HBM扩建项目

summary.en: Micron broke ground on a $9.3 billion expansion project in Hiroshima, with HBM shipments expected in the second half of 2028. The timing is important: new high-bandwidth memory capacity arriving in 2028 speaks to sustained AI demand, not a short-cycle spot shortage. It also adds another Japan-based node to the memory supply chain as customers try to diversify beyond Korea-heavy HBM sourcing.
summary.zh: Micron在广岛启动总额93亿美元的扩建项目，HBM出货预计在2028年下半年开始。这个时间点重要：2028年才释放的新HBM产能说明行业押注的是持续AI需求，而不是短周期现货缺口。该项目也为存储供应链增加了一个日本基地，帮助客户降低对韩国HBM供给的集中度。

title.en: Nomura argues memory's feared headwinds are delayed or demand-positive
title.zh: Nomura称存储两大逆风被高估或反而利多需求

summary.en: Nomura pushed back on two concerns for memory stocks: Korean capacity expansion is described as a distant solution, and Meta's AI compute leasing is framed as demand support rather than demand destruction. The point is that lead times matter more than headline capex when HBM and DDR5 supply is already allocated. For memory makers, the risk is less near-term oversupply than whether customers keep paying for scarce high-end bits through the next investment wave.
summary.zh: Nomura反驳了存储股面临的两项担忧：韩国扩产被视为较远期的解法，而Meta租赁AI算力被解读为需求支撑而非需求破坏。关键在于，当HBM和DDR5供给已经被分配时，交付周期比资本开支标题更重要。对存储厂而言，近期风险不是马上过剩，而是客户能否在下一轮投资中继续为稀缺高端bit付费。

title.en: Apple's A20 Pro is rumored to move to a 96-bit LPDDR6 interface
title.zh: Apple A20 Pro据称将转向96位LPDDR6接口

summary.en: A supply-chain rumor says Apple's A20 Pro may abandon its long-running 64-bit mobile memory convention for a 96-bit LPDDR6 interface, while offsetting cost pressure with NAND choices. If accurate, the change would point to higher local AI and graphics bandwidth needs in the iPhone 18 Pro generation. It also shows how memory cost is becoming a system-level tradeoff, not a component line item.
summary.zh: 供应链传闻称，Apple A20 Pro可能放弃长期采用的64位移动内存惯例，改用96位LPDDR6接口，并通过NAND配置抵消成本压力。如果属实，这意味着iPhone 18 Pro一代的本地AI和图形负载需要更高带宽。它也说明内存成本正在变成系统级取舍，而不只是单一元件成本。

title.en: Silicon Motion shows SM8008 and SM8388 enterprise SSD controllers
title.zh: Silicon Motion展示SM8008与SM8388企业级SSD控制器

summary.en: Silicon Motion showed its SM8008 and SM8388 enterprise SSD controllers at Computex 2026. Controller roadmaps matter because AI storage demand is not only about NAND bits; it also depends on latency, queue depth, firmware maturity, and power behavior in dense servers. The announcement keeps third-party controller vendors in the enterprise SSD race as hyperscale storage tiers expand.
summary.zh: Silicon Motion在Computex 2026展示了SM8008和SM8388企业级SSD控制器。控制器路线图重要，是因为AI存储需求不只取决于NAND bit，还取决于延迟、队列深度、固件成熟度和高密度服务器中的功耗表现。随着超大规模存储层扩张，第三方控制器厂商仍在企业级SSD竞争中占有位置。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: ASML's July 15 update becomes a test for China exports and High-NA EUV
title.zh: ASML 7月15日更新将检验中国出口与High-NA EUV需求

summary.en: ASML's next earnings update is being framed around two variables: China export exposure and the pace of High-NA EUV adoption. That is the right lens for the equipment stack because ASML's backlog depends on both policy permissions and customer willingness to absorb the next lithography cost step. Any shift in China revenue or High-NA timing would ripple into leading-node foundry and memory capex plans.
summary.zh: ASML下一次业绩更新被市场聚焦在两个变量上：中国出口敞口和High-NA EUV导入速度。这个观察角度适合设备链，因为ASML的积压订单同时取决于政策许可和客户承担下一代光刻成本的意愿。中国收入或High-NA时间表的任何变化，都会传导到领先制程代工和存储资本开支计划。

title.en: A semiconductor manufacturing test bed rides on a Falcon 9 launch
title.zh: 半导体制造测试平台搭乘Falcon 9发射

summary.en: A semiconductor manufacturing test bed is flying alongside Starlink satellites on a Falcon 9 mission, according to Spaceflight Now coverage in the candidate feed. The item is early-stage rather than a production supply story, but it signals continued experimentation with off-Earth processing environments. For materials and process engineers, the question is whether microgravity can produce repeatable advantages that justify launch and recovery costs.
summary.zh: 候选源中Spaceflight Now的报道显示，一个半导体制造测试平台正随Falcon 9任务与Starlink卫星一同发射。这不是量产供应新闻，而是早期工艺实验信号，表明行业仍在探索地外加工环境。对材料和工艺工程师而言，关键问题是微重力能否带来可重复优势，并足以覆盖发射和回收成本。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: YMTC SSDs appear in retail Lenovo laptops despite U.S. restrictions
title.zh: 受美国限制的YMTC SSD出现在Lenovo零售笔记本中

summary.en: Tom's Hardware reports that Lenovo has begun using YMTC SSDs in some retail laptop models, despite YMTC's place on the U.S. Commerce Department Entity List and its Pentagon designation as a Chinese military company. The drives were criticized in a review as below average for an office-laptop SSD, but the policy signal is more important than the benchmark. Restricted suppliers can still surface through global OEM bills of materials, making enforcement and sourcing audits more complicated.
summary.zh: Tom's Hardware报道称，Lenovo已在部分零售笔记本型号中采用YMTC SSD，尽管YMTC被列入美国商务部实体清单，并被五角大楼认定为中国军方企业。评测中该PCIe 4.0 SSD被批评为办公室笔记本中表现低于平均水平，但政策信号比单次基准测试更重要。受限制供应商仍可能通过全球OEM物料清单进入市场，这让执法和采购审计更复杂。

theme.en: Inference Efficiency Moves Below the Model
theme.zh: 推理效率下沉到模型之下

dek.en: This week's stronger papers treat memory, power, retrieval, and token movement as first-class constraints. The through-line is not bigger models, but methods that make existing hardware behave more predictably under long-context, multimodal, and accelerator-bound workloads.
dek.zh: 本周较强的论文把内存、功耗、检索和token移动作为一等约束。主线不是更大的模型，而是让现有硬件在长上下文、多模态和受加速器约束的负载下表现得更可预测。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Reflectionless resonant microwave plasmas via virtual critical coupling
title.zh: 通过虚拟临界耦合实现无反射谐振微波等离子体

summary.en: Akram and Semnani show a transient excitation scheme that keeps a resonant microwave plasma source impedance-matched after plasma ignition perturbs the resonator. The method uses an exponentially growing incident waveform to emulate critical coupling and reportedly stores up to four times as much energy in the resonator. It is process-adjacent rather than a transistor paper, but better plasma power transfer is relevant to compact industrial plasma tools and materials processing.
summary.zh: Akram和Semnani提出一种瞬态激励方案，在等离子体点火扰动谐振器后仍保持谐振微波等离子体源的阻抗匹配。该方法用指数增长的入射波形模拟临界耦合，据称可让谐振器储存最多4倍能量。它不是晶体管论文，而是偏工艺设备方向；但更高效的等离子体功率传输对紧凑型工业等离子体工具和材料处理有直接相关性。

title.en: Circuits & Architecture
title.zh: 电路与架构

title.en: Hardware-enforced semantic coordination for real-time autonomous systems
title.zh: 面向实时自治系统的硬件强制语义协同

papers.authors: U. M. Borghoff, P. Bottoni, R. Pareschi

summary.en: Borghoff, Bottoni, and Pareschi map selected coordination semantics for safety-critical autonomous systems directly onto FPGA primitives. The contribution is not raw acceleration; it is bounded-latency enforcement of interaction rules among heterogeneous AI, control, and human-operated components. The paper is architecture-level and still needs implementation evidence, but it points to a useful hardware role for verifiable real-time AI systems.
summary.zh: Borghoff、Bottoni和Pareschi把安全关键自治系统中的部分协同语义直接映射到FPGA原语上。它的贡献不是单纯加速，而是在异构AI、控制和人工组件之间以有界延迟强制执行交互规则。论文仍处在架构层，需要更多实现证据，但它指出了硬件在可验证实时AI系统中的一个有价值角色。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: WattGPU predicts LLM inference power and latency on unseen GPUs
title.zh: WattGPU预测未知GPU上的LLM推理功耗与延迟

papers.authors: M. Fadel Argerich, J. Fuerst, M. Patino-Martinez

summary.en: WattGPU predicts mean GPU power draw and inter-token latency for LLM inference using only public model metadata and GPU specifications. On 42 open-source LLMs and 8 NVIDIA server GPUs, the paper reports median absolute percentage error at or below 3.4% for offline power and 13.5% for server-mode power on unseen GPUs, with server-mode latency error at or below 8.5%. If it generalizes, this gives operators a planning tool before they spend time profiling every model-and-GPU pair.
summary.zh: WattGPU只使用公开模型元数据和GPU规格，预测LLM推理的平均GPU功耗和token间延迟。论文在42个开源LLM和8款NVIDIA服务器GPU上报告，面对未见过的GPU，离线功耗中位绝对百分比误差不超过3.4%，服务器模式功耗不超过13.5%，服务器模式延迟误差不超过8.5%。如果泛化成立，它能让运营方在逐一实测模型与GPU组合之前先完成容量和能耗规划。

title.en: Dendritic in-context learning in a single-layer spiking neural network
title.zh: 单层脉冲神经网络中的树突式上下文学习

papers.authors: J. Shen, Y. Wu, C. Chen

summary.en: Shen, Wu, and Chen argue that a single dendritic compartment can implement the online learning dynamics needed for in-context learning in spiking neural networks. Their DendriCL architecture maps apical recurrence to a leaky Widrow-Hoff LMS update, reducing what would normally require deeper transformer-like machinery. The result is promising for neuromorphic architecture thinking, but the evidence is algorithmic; it is not yet a measured silicon macro.
summary.zh: Shen、Wu和Chen认为，单个树突隔室即可实现脉冲神经网络中上下文学习所需的在线学习动力学。其DendriCL架构把顶端递归映射为带泄漏的Widrow-Hoff LMS更新，从而压缩通常需要更深Transformer式机制才能完成的适应过程。这个结果对神经形态架构有启发，但证据仍是算法层面的，并非已测硅宏单元。

title.en: AI Research for Systems
title.zh: 面向系统的AI研究

title.en: OrbitQuant: data-agnostic quantization for diffusion transformers
title.zh: OrbitQuant：面向扩散Transformer的数据无关量化

papers.authors: D. Lee, J. Chavan, D. Nguyen, et al.

summary.en: OrbitQuant removes calibration-data dependence from post-training quantization for diffusion transformers by rotating activations into a normalized basis with a randomized permuted block-Hadamard transform. The same Lloyd-Max codebook can then serve many timesteps, prompts, layers, and even image-to-video transfers, according to the paper. The hardware relevance is direct: lower-bit DiT inference is only useful if quantization avoids per-checkpoint calibration overhead and preserves quality across long sampling chains.
summary.zh: OrbitQuant通过随机置换块Hadamard变换，把扩散Transformer的激活旋转到归一化基空间，从而去掉后训练量化对校准数据的依赖。论文称，同一个Lloyd-Max码本可服务多个时间步、提示、层，甚至从图像模型迁移到视频模型。其硬件相关性很直接：低比特DiT推理只有在避免逐检查点校准开销并保持长采样链质量时才真正有用。

title.en: Entropy-aware dense visual token pruning for VLMs
title.zh: 面向VLM的熵感知密集视觉token剪枝

papers.authors: X. Wang, X. Yang, W. Shen

summary.en: EADP targets the failure mode where visual token pruning drops fine-grained cues under dense multimodal instructions. It estimates textual noise with entropy, then uses submodular selection with a spatial prior instead of naive top-k token retention. For accelerator workloads, the paper is relevant because visual-token count is a first-order driver of memory traffic and attention compute in VLM inference.
summary.zh: EADP针对视觉token剪枝在密集多模态指令下丢失细粒度线索的问题。它先用熵估计文本噪声，再以带空间先验的子模选择替代简单Top-K保留。对加速器负载而言，这篇论文相关性很高，因为视觉token数量直接决定VLM推理中的内存流量和attention计算量。

title.en: HOLA adds exact bounded KV memory to linear attention
title.zh: HOLA为线性attention加入有界精确KV记忆

summary.en: HOLA augments linear attention with a bounded exact KV cache so facts that do not compress well into the recurrent state can still be recalled. At 340M parameters trained on 15B SlimPajama tokens, the paper reports Wikitext perplexity improving from 27.32 to 22.92, beating a full-attention Transformer++ baseline at 26.88. The approach is hardware-relevant because it keeps the linear-attention memory model while adding a controlled cache path for high-value associations.
summary.zh: HOLA在线性attention之外加入有界精确KV cache，让无法良好压缩进递归状态的事实仍可被召回。在使用15B SlimPajama token训练的340M参数模型上，论文报告Wikitext困惑度从27.32降至22.92，优于26.88的全attention Transformer++基线。该方法对硬件有意义，因为它保留线性attention的内存模型，同时为高价值关联增加受控cache路径。

title.en: HNSW with accuracy guarantees using graph spanners
title.zh: 用图spanner为HNSW提供准确性保证

papers.authors: M. Li, R. Mittal, S. Rana, et al.

summary.en: Li et al. propose a certify-then-rectify framework for HNSW nearest-neighbor search, adding a statistical certifier that escalates uncertain queries to a rigorous recovery path. They reinterpret the HNSW graph as a geometric spanner and use extreme-value estimates to bound where true nearest neighbors can lie. The systems angle is clear: vector retrieval for RAG and memory systems needs predictable worst-case behavior, not only high average throughput.
summary.zh: Li等人提出面向HNSW近邻搜索的“先认证、再修正”框架，加入统计认证器，在查询结果不可靠时升级到严格恢复路径。他们把HNSW图重新解释为几何spanner，并用极值估计限定真实近邻可能出现的位置。系统意义很明确：RAG和记忆系统中的向量检索不仅需要高平均吞吐，还需要可预测的最坏情况行为。

title.en: Quantum & Emerging Computing
title.zh: 量子与新型计算

title.en: Optimal stabilizer testing and learning with limited quantum memory
title.zh: 有限量子内存下的最优稳定子测试与学习

summary.en: Arunachalam and Schatzki study stabilizer-state testing and learning when an algorithm can keep only k qubits of coherent quantum memory between measurements. They show the usual separation between constant-copy testing and larger learning complexity disappears under memory limits, with stabilizer testing requiring Theta(n-k) samples and non-adaptive learning requiring Theta(n^2/k). The result is theoretical, but it sharpens the memory requirements for practical quantum characterization protocols.
summary.zh: Arunachalam和Schatzki研究当算法在测量之间只能保留k个相干量子比特内存时的稳定子态测试与学习。他们证明，在内存受限下，常数拷贝测试与更高学习复杂度之间的传统分离会消失：稳定子测试需要Theta(n-k)个样本，非自适应学习需要Theta(n^2/k)。这是理论结果，但它更清楚地刻画了实用量子表征协议的内存需求。
